english: Tiffania...?\nWhat are you doing?
...Um, nothing in particular...
But you were looking around...
Huh!? Was I?\n...Was I doing that...
Actually, something's been bothering me...
Lately I feel like someone's watching me.
Someone... you mean like a stalker?
Stalker...?\nWhat does that mean?
Um... it means someone's interested in you\nand secretly follows you around...
Interested...?\nI don't really understand, but...\nI don't think it's like that.
It's more like... the way other people\nlook at me bothers me a little.
Is something wrong with me?\nOr did I do something strange?
No, I don't think anything's wrong,\nor that you did anything...
Then... what could possibly\nbe the cause...
Maybe I did something\nto offend someone.
Hmm, really...?\nCouldn't it just be your imagination?
I hope so...\nBut I'm worried...
I haven't really\ninteracted with many people...
Maybe it's because you're beautiful, Tiffania...
N-no.\nMe... there are plenty of\nbeautiful people here.
No need to be so modest...\nIf not, it's probably a misunderstanding.
The more you worry, the more you'll notice.\nYour attention just goes there...
Is that... how it is...
There's really nothing to worry about.\nJust be yourself, like always.
Is... that so?
Okay.\nI'll try not to worry.
Thank you for hearing me out.
But if you notice anything,\nanything at all, please\ntell me.
I want to be friends with everyone.
That feeling alone... is enough.\nEveryone feels the same way.
Yes, I pray\nthat's true.
...Tiffania?\nAre you feeling down?
...Yes.
It's about what I mentioned before-\nbeing watched by someone.
It turns out I was the cause after all.\nI was too scared to say it then...
The cause?
Did you do something bad?
Nothing bad, but in a way...\nmaybe it is bad.
Being beautiful...?
Huh? N-no!\nI'm not beautiful!\nIt's not that...
I'm a half-elf.\nThat's probably what's\nmaking everyone uneasy.
Since long ago, half-elves and humans\nhave fought.
Humans saw half-elves as a threat,\nand half-elves saw humans the same way.
I think that deeply rooted belief\nis making them see me as an enemy.
At this point, accepting a half-elf like me\nmust be difficult.
...Hmm.\nI don't think that's true, though...
I-it's not?\nBut...
It's true I made friends\nat the Tristain Academy of Magic.
But to everyone I met on this journey,\nI'm just a half-elf.
Accepting me... must be hard.\nI was prepared for that...
I see, so that's how it is in your world.\nBut in my world it's different.
Different?\nLike a world where humans\nand elves get along?
Who knows?\nI don't know the details, but\nthere are worlds with no elves at all.
I doubt many people think of\nhalf-elves as enemies.\nProbably...
Huh? Really?\nWas I jumping to conclusions...
I thought elves and humans fought\neverywhere and hated each other...
You're right.\nDifferent worlds, different ideas.\nMy common sense doesn't apply here.
...I doubted everyone\nbased on my own assumptions...
Being anxious is... natural.\nBy the way, do you dislike\nhalf-elves, Tiffania?
No, not at all...\nI'm glad to be who I am.\nThat's how I feel.
Then you should be proud\nof being a half-elf.\nOtherwise it'd be sad.
...Yes!\nThank you!
(I'm not confident myself, but...\nI'm saying weirdly positive things...)
Be proud of being\na half-elf... got it!
I'll try!\nAnd also...
Just knowing everyone doesn't see\nhalf-elves as enemies\nmade me happy.
Can I come to you with my worries\nagain sometime?
Yes... of course.
Thank you.\nI'm so happy!
(Well, half-elves are probably rare\nin any world...)
(They might just be staring\nout of simple curiosity...)
Um... could you\nhear me out?
S-sure... I'm listening.\nDid something happen?
Nobody will look\nme in the eye.
I thought it was my imagination again,\nbut I can't convince myself it is...
They look away right away,\nso I can't help but wonder...
Huh. Why, I wonder?
(Still...)
...You're the same.
Guh-... w-what!?
Everyone looks down the same way.\nAt my chest, for some reason.
Does that mean they don't want\nto meet my eyes?
It's hard to ask them directly...\nI wanted to confirm with you,\n...and you're the same.
N-no, it's not that...\nIt's just, your chest... um...\nit's big, so it catches my eye.
N-no way...!\nUm... this is embarrassing.\nStop looking over here so much!!
Louise looks at my chest too...\nand sometimes makes a really\ndisgusted face...
...Is something wrong?\nWith my...?
No, nothing's wrong.\nIt's just big... and.
Louise's case is... probably different.\nI don't think she dislikes you or anything.
But... I'm pretty sure\nshe looks at my chest.
That's part of what makes you you, Tiffa.\nNobody's denying that.
...Ugh...\nIt's still embarrassing...
But... actually, not everyone\nreacts the same way.
Some people look at my chest\nand seem really angry...
I don't know what to do...
...Ah, that's...\nprobably jealousy...\nSame as Louise earlier.
Jealousy...?\nWhy would anyone be jealous...
It's like wanting what you don't have...\nor chasing an ideal...
Huh? Um, I don't really get it...
You mean my big chest\nmakes someone jealous?
Why would that happen?\nIs it because I'm a half-elf after all...
That's... unrelated.\nIt's purely admiration and wanting\nwhat you don't have, creating friction...
Hah...\nIs that how it is?
I see...\nThough I don't really understand.
(She's tilting her head a lot...\nI might've confused her...)
Hah... hah... ngh...
Tiffania? You're breathing hard.
I-I'm fine!
I'm just... trying\nin my own way.
So don't worry...\nI'm perfectly fine.
But... your clothes look different somehow,\nor no, they're the same, but...
Is the extra room around your chest... the same thing?
Geez, i-it's embarrassing,\nso stop looking!!
Right now... I have to endure.
Because I want to be friends with everyone.\nHah... hah...
I want to do\neverything I can.
You're making a troubled face...\nMaybe you shouldn't do that...
But I don't know what else I can do.
Um, the direction of your effort...\nis going the wrong way, I think.
I don't think there's another way.\nBecause I'm the cause.
Even so, you're straining so hard,\nyou're leaning forward.
I'm fine! I can stand up straight!\nSee...
Ah!?
Your chest got bigger...?\nNo, it just went back to normal...\nThe slack in your clothes is gone...
...This is embarrassing...
I went through the trouble of wrapping\nbandages... Failure.
Bandages?\n...Are you hurt?
N-no,\nsomeone told me.
There's something called sarashi\nthat's good for binding your chest.
But I don't have sarashi,\nso I tried wrapping bandages.
Hoping it'd look even a little smaller...
I-I see...\nBut you don't have to force yourself to hide it...
It's embarrassing,\nso don't look!
If it's that embarrassing, why do it...
But I guess... that's not an option,\nis it? For you, Tiffa...
...Tiffania.\nYou're not binding this time, huh.
...Right.
No need to look so down.\nYou don't have to force yourself.
I want to be like everyone else.
I don't want people looking at me weirdly-\nI want to spend time as friends.
Then I think you've already done that.
But my chest is weird, right?\nThat's why everyone stares, right?
So I thought I'd hide\nthe weird part.
It didn't work, though...
Pfft... hee.
W-what's so funny!
Guh... hee hee hee...!
That's... mean, laughing at me.\nI'm seriously worried here.
You don't understand how sad I feel.
Otherwise you wouldn't laugh\nso loudly.
S-sorry... I didn't mean to laugh...\nBut I thought that earnest side of you\nis part of what makes you Tiffania.
Huh? What do you mean?
You have a very... kind side.
That's not true.\nI'm just desperate about a lot of things.
And a very... hasty side.
Really?\nI think things through in my own way...
Y-your b-b-big chest is... one of your charms, I think.\nBut what have you been thinking about lately, Tiffania?
Well, because I want to get along with everyone,\nI've tried talking to people,\nand fixing my weird parts.
I've tried not\nto do anything offensive.
And when I still thought\nI might have some fault,\nI looked for it.
Basically, I looked for things\nabout myself I could fix.
But everyone's so charming,\nso I have to make an effort to be friends with them…….
It's okay. Everyone feels the same way.\nNobody's going to hate Tiffania-san for trying that hard.
Eh?
Try looking at everyone properly, a little more.\nAnd at yourself, too.
……I wasn't really\nlistening to what other people were saying.
'They hate me,' 'I'm weird'……\nI was deciding all of that on my own.
Even though maybe nobody\nreally thought that.
So…… you don't need to worry about it.
Ah, um… thank you so much!\nI'll really try talking with everyone!
I'm glad to see Tiffania-san\nseems to have cheered up.
It's nothing big, but\nthere's something I wanted to ask…….
Hmm?　What is it?\nIf it's something I'd know…….
Um…… you once told me\nnot to worry about it.
But if I'm not weird, then\nwhat are my good points?
……What's with that question?
Please think of it\nlike a survey of sorts.
It's not like I want to ask anything weird.\nI just want to have a little more confidence in myself, sort of.
So that's what this is.\nPlease, will you tell me?
That you're very kind……\nYour thoughtfulness is wonderful.
Hee hee.\nThank you.
You always compliment me for being kind.
That being a half-elf is cool…….
Huh?　That's a bit of an unexpected answer.\nCool…… really?
Hm!?　I feel someone's eyes on me……\nUm, are you looking at my chest?
Huh?　No, I never said that.\nYour chest, I mean-no.
Huh?　But I saw you glance,\nso I thought maybe…….
Just a little curious, then?
It's fine.\nI used to worry about it until recently, though…….
But now it's turning\ninto a bit of confidence.
I-is that so.
Then, among everyone else,\nwho do you like?
Huh!?　L-like……!?
Everyone's so charming,\nI'd like to use them as reference.
What kind of person a man is interested in…….
E-everyone's charming……\nI couldn't choose…… not me.
I see…… of course.\nUnderstood. Thank you.
I'll take that as reference.
……That was a direct question.
What are you after, asking questions like that?\nNot like you'd tell me if I asked.
……Um, er…… how do…… I look?
I did some studying.\nOn attractive women.
Um……\nYou look like the usual Tiffania-san to me.
This!\nI incorporated an item.
A riding crop!
Why would you have something like that?\nI'm…… not following at all…….
I wanted to learn from Louise-san,\nso I borrowed this.
I asked Louise-san, as an attractive woman,\nand she said she has something like this.
Louise-san's older sister supposedly has a whip too,\nthough a different kind.
S-so, how is it?
Even if you ask me 'how'……\nthis is a tough one…….
I-is it no good?
Carrying a riding crop around…… isn't normal.
So you're saying I have to actually use it?
That's true……\nJust holding a whip would be weird.\nA tool has to be used.
Th-then!　I'll use it!
Ow!?
Huh?　A-are you okay!?\nIt does hurt, right?
……It hurts…….
O-of course!\nBut a whip's whole purpose\nis hitting things, so…….
……Well, this has its own appeal…….
Um…… it doesn't hurt……?\nEven though you're being whipped…….
Ugh……\nIs this what 'good' is?
I've never whipped anyone,\nso…….
It makes me feel like\nI'm doing something bad…….
I think you've got it wrong……\nWhipping people isn't\nLouise-san's good point…….
Huh!?　It's not!?\nI-I…… I was wrong again, wasn't I.
I thought something felt off.\nPeople don't normally do this.
But Louise-san carried a whip along with her wand,\nso I thought that was normal…….
I'm sorry……\nfor troubling you……\nI'll go study some more.
Tiffania-san!　W-wait!\n……And she's gone…….
At this rate she's going to keep\nheading in the wrong direction…….
I have to properly stop Tiffania-san,\nor she might really go off in a strange direction…….
Sorry to keep you waiting.
Tiffania-san?　What's it this time?\n……Huh!?
Come, no point standing around here.\nLet's go.
Go…… where?
……So?　Is it weird?\nI tried wearing different clothes than usual?
Um…… I think it suits you.\nBut why here?
Last time I tried learning from Louise-san,\nbut that didn't seem right…….
This time I tried learning from Siesta-san.
Siesta-san takes care of nobles,\nright?
So today I became a café waitress\nto try something similar.
I'm not used to it…… I don't really get it.\nBut I'll do my best.
Then, allow me to serve you.
Serve?
Yes. Siesta-san taught me.
That maids serve.
I see…….
Tiffania-san?　What are you going to do for me?
S-service!
But what am I supposed to do for 'service'?\nWhen it comes down to it…… I don't know…….
*Pff*, that's right!
Ugh…… don't laugh.\nIt's my first time, so…….
Siesta-san never told me what it actually involves…….
Ahaha…… sorry, it's just a little funny……\nThen, shall we just talk together?
Just talk?　That's no different from usual, though?
I don't think what Siesta-san does\nis that kind of thing?
I think that counts, too.
Haa…… that's service too…… I don't get it.
……But talking is fun, so\nif that's okay…….
Hey, I…….
Um~?　You'll catch a cold sleeping in a place like this.
Nn…… Tefa-san……?\n……Pff…… hehe.
Huh?　Why are you laughing at my face?\nWas something funny?
No.\nI just thought, Tiffania-san is Tiffania-san even in my dreams.
What do you mean?\nMe in a dream……?
……N-n-nothing at all.\nLet's keep getting along.\nTiffania-san.
Y-yes!\nI don't quite get it, but……\nLet's!
